description_en: Queries the IP address and line information of an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防实例的IP和线路信息
name: DescribeInstanceDetails

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID列表
parameters.name: instance_ids

InstanceDetails.description_en: The IP address and line information of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
InstanceDetails.description_zh: DDoS高防实例的IP和线路信息

EipInfos.description_en: The IP information of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance

CertConfigured.description_en: Indicates whether a custom certificate is configured
CertConfigured.description_zh: 是否配置了自定义证书

Eip.description_en: The Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium IP address

IpMode.description_en:
The IP forwarding mode. Valid values:

fnat: The IP versions of the origin server and the client are the same. IPv4 client requests are forwarded to IPv4 origin servers, and IPv6 client requests are forwarded to IPv6 origin servers.
v6tov4: IPv6 client requests are forwarded to IPv4 origin servers
IpMode.description_zh:
IP转发模式。取值：

fnat：表示源站和客户端的IP版本一致，即IPv4地址客户端请求转发到IPv4地址源站、IPv6地址客户端请求转发到IPv6地址源站。
v6tov4：表示IPv6地址客户端请求转发到IPv4地址源站

IpVersion.description_en:
The IP protocol version. Valid values:

Ipv4: IPv4.
Ipv6: IPv6
IpVersion.description_zh:
IP协议版本。取值：

Ipv4：表示IPv4协议。
Ipv6：表示IPv6协议

Status.description_en:
The status of the Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium IP address. Valid values:

normal: Normal.
expired: Expired.
defense: Cleaning.
blackhole: Black Hole Activated.
punished: Penalized
Status.description_zh:
DDoS高防IP的状态。取值：

normal：表示正常。
expired：表示已过期。
defense：表示清洗中。
blackhole：表示黑洞中。
punished：表示处罚中

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance

Line.description_en: The protection line of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
